translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Ea wane kima maep kopne, kine kine yalinane Anutuŋo biŋek qe ŋebo ŋebonane ŋene maine kine kine qotkoineŋo koto so solazo maki sigile okanmaike, ea sauk walalakkene, so Anutu ewine kito more kotoze qelaŋangorop gekene.
Paulo, Eŋe Korinti Matkoŋine Kisi Dere More Wetine Menaŋge
Ŋine kotoŋine misuk mawaluke ŋebongei. Ŋene masi kine kine borikine ŋinano mane mi okangone, ŋene ŋine matali qetali mi okan ŋungone, me kine kine mane yaup mi makone.
Na don iwa ŋinane detpe boriki mi ramaile, na mo alakan ŋidanile, ŋene wetzeŋo lukŋunmaine, eamo ŋinerop weneŋ gekenane me seukkenane.
Na wetneŋo ŋinaneka zok motpe paki, manerop ra ewek ma ŋunmaile, Na wetne zok ma pese pesenane, wikile kine kine kotino wetpese zok suaine detmaile.
Ŋene Makedonia kepeo sari lotke more yaleka daleo kito peseluke geŋem rap. Iwa solaoken kawali so kotooken kaet, kine kine yewaŋo wakone qepok mapok okan ŋongi gekone.
Wanap magunut onmaike, Anutu, oŋo yemo siluŋ ŋenane kito pese qe pesezane Titus birakaki zingeke.

So eŋe zingeke ea waneka mida, ŋine wet menaŋ don olatkoi, ea masariki dere more wetze peseke. So na detnane gemami, so qom borik korop ge okanmami, so naŋane ra more urataŋine qesiŋkau paki sorin borin okan okanmami, ea nolatki wet pese suaine detkole.
Na alakan kibi mane qe ŋibone more, qom wikile ma wakone ŋibongole, ea wane wetne mi borimaike. Qe ŋibongole, naso nigatne yewao eamo welekatne wetne borike.

Pakimo iwa yemo wet pesek detmaile, eamo ŋine zok wikile detkoi, ea wane midaka, qom wikileŋo ŋinano wet mai main ma wakonge, ea wane qomne menaŋmaike. Anutu dereretinane rokopko qom wikile mayakatne detkoi, wane ŋenane donzeŋo mi matali ŋunge.

Qom wikile mayakatne yewaŋo wet mai main ma wakongi ŋei menaŋgene, paki qom wikile yaline maratkayakeŋo ŋado ea wane mi detki boriake. Ŋo qom wikile sigitne me diinerop, ŋei dereret wane rokopko wakon okanmaike, eaŋo yemo wet qelaŋ mawakongi seu seu maratkaikene.

Kau! Anutuŋo ŋinane qom wikile ŋine mayakakatne ea wane ŋinano wele zok manerop ma wakonge, yemo ewe ewek, kine ma wakon ma wakon, borikine mapapka mapapka, kaet qeli qeliŋ, dere worik, sorin borin, makoboe makoboe! Kine kine yale ma wakonge, pakimo ŋinano borikine motke motke, so qesi qesiŋ mi pamaike, ea wane kine tingo wakonge.

Eso Na kibi yewa qe ŋibongole, yemo ŋei borikine make, ea wane midaka, me borikine okan onge eŋane midaka, don ŋidanŋem Anutu wane kaitko ŋenano aŋa tewe tewek ŋinane kine wakoniake, ea wane qe ŋibongole.
Eso ŋine yale okanbi paki wetze ma pesekoi. So wetze ma pesekoi eaka midaka, ŋine koropŋo Titusi qesiŋka more wet pese okankau zingeki ŋene zok manerop detŋem menaŋge.
Na alakan solaŋine mawa more Titus olatkole, don yewa isi mi okange. Ŋine don ŋidanbe welerop okanwareke, yalewaka ŋine mawaŋune more Titus don olatkole ea yaleka weleropka okange.
Titusi eŋe ŋinano uki ŋine ewine kitou paki aŋaine tewekkoi, eŋe ea wane wetkeki paki wetineŋo ŋinane zok okan kamaike.
Na wetne menaŋmaike, yemo ŋinane rawe paki dere qeka midaine maine gekale.
